description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of question sources within a dataset, showing contributions from several question-answering (QA) datasets. The chart contains five slices, each representing a different QA dataset. The largest slice, labeled “TriviaQA”, is a light gray color and represents 46% of the data (1829 instances). “WebQA” is represented by a purple slice and accounts for 25% (997 instances). A smaller, tan slice represents 6% (231 instances) with no specific label beyond this percentage. “HalluEval” is shown as a dark green slice, representing 18% (721 instances), while “HalluQA” is a medium green slice representing 5% (85 instances). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is present in the upper right corner. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their proportional representation.
